newsitem.title: USA: Galileo shares plunge after loss warning.
newsitem.headline: Galileo shares plunge after loss warning.

text.p: Galileo Corp lost two-thirds of its value Thursday, a day after the fiber and electro-optic company warned it would likely post a loss in fiscal 1997.
The stock fell 12-5/8 to six, or about 68 percent, in late morning trading.
Galileo said Wednesday it would likely suffer a loss for the year after losing Xerox Corp as a customer for its products.
Galileo said the Xerox business accounted for 48 percent of its revenues in fiscal 1996, or $20.4 million of its total sales of $42.6 million.
